library.training_exclusion: Both cold-test events are excluded before quote-shape fitting.
partition: first one-tick-spread lawful-book bid price region

decision_tree.macro: Category and price region initialize every fitted topology.
decision_tree.micro: Exact fitted ask-net/dip distance minima eliminate shapes first; dwell, spread, cadence, displayed size, and top-five depth resolve only the surviving tie.
decision_tree.pair: A direction independently resolved from one legs quote path removes non-inverse directions on the sibling; a constrained sibling cannot circularly confirm the source leg.
decision_tree.micro_micro: PLACE is available only after an own ask transition at a later timestamp, independently observed inverse sibling direction, current ask equal to the running ask low, continuous ask dwell, and displayed capacity.
decision_tree.monotonicity: An eliminated shape never returns during the event.
decision_tree.joint_clock: A lawful update on either book advances dwell and re-evaluates both carried contemporaneous books.

ask_dwell_seconds.provenance: Inherited unchanged from the frozen 598-event primary quote-touch comparator in arb-executor/docs/research/window1/WINDOW1_ORGAN_SCORECARD_AND_DEFECT_LEDGER.md; not selected on either cold game.

shape_distance_tolerance.provenance: No tolerance is introduced; exact minimum distance under training-fitted standardization is used layer by layer.
